parameters.name: FirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC boundary firewall.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: ShouldRecover
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to restore the traffic redirection configuration. Valid values:

- true: Rolls back the route.

- false: Revokes the route.

parameters.name: TrFirewallRoutePolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the routing policy for the firewall.

parameters.name: TrFirewallRoutePolicySwitchStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the policy. Valid values:

- open: Enables the policy.

- close: Disables the policy.
